title: MissingPatterns.jl: terminal-based exploration of missing data patterns in Julia
description:
MissingPatterns.jl is a Julia package for exploring missing data patterns in any Tables.jl-compatible source (DataFrame, CSV.File, NamedTuple of vectors, row tables, ...).

It renders missing-value heatmaps (plotmissing), unique missingness patterns (missingpatterns, the diagnostic produced by R's mice::md.pattern()), per-column summaries with sparklines (missingsummary), pairwise phi/Jaccard co-occurrence of missingness masks (missingcooccurrence) and before/after diffs for auditing imputation steps (plotmissingdiff) directly in the terminal, using Unicode and ANSI truecolor and with no plotting-library dependencies. The same heatmap can be exported as a self-contained HTML fragment (missinghtml).
